# Setting-Up Obsidian For Documenation (SUOFD)

To set up obsidian we'll need a on plugin and a few tweaks on obsidian and Github with to use with Github actions to render the images From github.

#### Plugins

*Image baker* install this plugin from the community plugins on Obsidian and enable it.
![Image-baker.png|542](data:image/png;base64,)

Edit the last line as shown above and close that window
Go  to __Settings__  --->   __Files and Links__ 
Then edit as shown below from the drop downs provided on obsidian.

![Open-Files.png|513](data:image/png;base64,)

Thats all for Obsidian so now we shift the focus to github:

- Signup to github if do not have a github account 
- Create a repo and give it  name of your choosing
- If you are not farmiliar with version control I'd recommend you watch some tutorials on Youtube on Git and Github
- Navigate to that specific repo then go to settings on far most right *the gear icon* opens the settings to that repo 


![Setting Up obsidian For documentation 20260811-125516.png](data:image/png;base64,)

- __Repo__ ---> __Settings__ ---> __Pages__ 

Toggle the drop down and choose Github actions
